description: Objective checks that the skill produces correct, natural Arabic and avoids machine-translation tells. Each eval lists a prompt and concrete, checkable expected behaviors. Run with and without the skill to measure the delta.

evals.prompt: Translate into Modern Standard Arabic: "The new cars are fast and the old books are interesting."
expected_behavior: Non-human plural subjects take feminine-singular agreement (e.g. السيارات الجديدة سريعة, الكتب القديمة مثيرة للاهتمام)
Does NOT use plural adjectives like سريعون/سريعات or جُدُد for the non-human nouns
Uses Arabic punctuation; no Latin comma/period mixed into the Arabic

evals.prompt: Translate into MSA: "The committee reviewed the plan and the company conducted a study of the market."
expected_behavior: Uses active voice with the agent named (e.g. راجعت اللجنة الخطة), not a من قبل passive
Uses a single verb (e.g. أجرت الشركة دراسة or درست الشركة) rather than قام/قامت بـ + verbal noun
Verb-before-subject (VSO) verbs are singular and agree only in gender

evals.prompt: Translate into MSA: "Update your account and review the company's policy."
expected_behavior: Renders 'your account' with an attached pronoun suffix (حسابك), not الحساب الخاص بك
Renders 'the company's policy' as an iḍāfa (سياسة الشركة), not السياسة الخاصة بالشركة
The first noun of the iḍāfa carries no ال and no tanwin

evals.prompt: Proofread and correct this Arabic, listing each fix: "انا ذهبت الى المدرسه , و قابلت ثلاث طلاب هناك ?"
expected_behavior: Fixes the hamza: انا → أنا, الى → إلى
Fixes ة/ه: المدرسه → المدرسة
Fixes number agreement/polarity for a masculine counted noun: ثلاث طلاب → ثلاثة طلاب
Replaces Latin punctuation with Arabic glyphs (، and ؟) and fixes spacing (no space before a mark)

evals.prompt: Translate into natural MSA: "In addition, the goal of the project is to play an important role in raising awareness, where the team made a decision to launch the campaign."
expected_behavior: Fronts the verb instead of the copular calque (e.g. يهدف المشروع إلى…, not الهدف من المشروع هو…)
Uses idiomatic collocations: يؤدّي/يضطلع بدور (not يلعب دورًا), اتخذ قرارًا (not عمل/أخذ قرارًا), نشر/رفع مستوى الوعي
Does not stack heavy connectors; avoids misusing حيث for a non-locative 'where' (uses إذ/الذي or restructures)
Reads as native MSA when read aloud, without needing the English to be intelligible

evals.prompt: Rewrite in natural Egyptian Arabic: "I want to go now; where is the restaurant?"
expected_behavior: Uses Egyptian markers: عايز/عاوز, دلوقتي, فين, and the question word at the end (المطعم فين؟)
Does not leak MSA (أريد أن أذهب الآن) or other dialects (بدّي/أبغى, هلّق/الحين)
Keeps a single consistent dialect throughout

evals.prompt: I'm writing the body text of a legal privacy policy in Arabic. Which register should I use, and translate this clause: "We do not share your data with third parties."
expected_behavior: Recommends Modern Standard Arabic for a legal document (not a dialect)
Produces correct MSA (e.g. لا نشارك بياناتك مع أطراف ثالثة) with an attached suffix for 'your', not الخاص بك
Tone is formal and natural, not stiff or calqued

evals.prompt: Translate for an Egyptian audience: "The conference will be held on January 15, 2026, and 75% of seats are reserved."
expected_behavior: Uses the Mashreq month name يناير (not the Levantine كانون الثاني) for an Egyptian audience
Places the percent sign to the left of the number with no space (75%), with the number running left-to-right
Uses a consistent numeral system throughout
